mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(model_version, 'unknown') AS modelVersion, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN scorecard_decision IN ('AUTO_PASS','AUTO_APPROVE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS autoApproveCount, SUM(CASE WHEN scorecard_decision = 'MANUAL_REVIEW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS manualReviewCount, SUM(CASE WHEN scorecard_decision = 'APPROVE_DOWNGRADE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downgradeCount, SUM(CASE WHEN scorecard_decision NOT IN ('AUTO_PASS','AUTO_APPROVE','MANUAL_REVIEW','APPROVE_DOWNGRADE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejectCount, ROUND(AVG(scorecard_score), 1) AS avgScore, MIN(scorecard_score) AS minScore, MAX(scorecard_score) AS maxScore, MIN(decision_time) AS firstTime, MAX(decision_time) AS lastTime FROM risk_decision_log GROUP BY COALESCE(model_version, 'unknown') ORDER BY totalCount DESC

SELECT COALESCE(model_version, 'unknown') AS modelVersion, FLOOR(scorecard_score / #{bucketSize}) AS bucket, #{bucketSize} AS bucketSize, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN decision_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recentCount, SUM(CASE WHEN decision_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS baseCount FROM risk_decision_log WHERE scorecard_score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY COALESCE(model_version, 'unknown'), FLOOR(scorecard_score / #{bucketSize}) ORDER BY modelVersion, bucket

SELECT FLOOR(scorecard_score / #{bucketSize}) AS bucket, #{bucketSize} AS bucketSize, COUNT(*) AS totalCount FROM risk_decision_log WHERE scorecard_score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FLOOR(scorecard_score / #{bucketSize}) ORDER BY bucket
